system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Armor security policy that blocks traffic from specific countries and rate-limits requests per IP.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Armor security policy that blocks traffic from specific countries and rate-limits requests per IP.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
imports:
- path: cloud-armor-policy.jinja

resources:
- name: cloud-armor-security-policy
  type: cloud-armor-policy.jinja
  properties:
    policyName: prod-cloud-armor-policy
    description: "Production Cloud Armor security policy with geo-blocking and rate limiting"
    blockedCountries:
      - CN
      - RU
      - KP
      - IR
    rateLimitThresholdCount: 100
    rateLimitIntervalSec: 60
    rateLimitBanDurationSec: 600
    enforceOnKey: IP
    adaptiveProtection: true
    logLevel: VERBOSE

---
# cloud-armor-policy.jinja
{% set policyName = properties['policyName'] %}
{% set description = properties['description'] %}
{% set blockedCountries = properties['blockedCountries'] %}
{% set rateLimitThresholdCount = properties['rateLimitThresholdCount'] %}
{% set rateLimitIntervalSec = properties['rateLimitIntervalSec'] %}
{% set rateLimitBanDurationSec = properties['rateLimitBanDurationSec'] %}
{% set enforceOnKey = properties['enforceOnKey'] %}
{% set adaptiveProtection = properties['adaptiveProtection'] %}
{% set logLevel = properties['logLevel'] %}

resources:
- name: {{ policyName }}
  type: gcp-types/compute-v1:securityPolicies
  properties:
    name: {{ policyName }}
    description: {{ description }}
    type: CLOUD_ARMOR
    adaptiveProtectionConfig:
      layer7DdosDefenseConfig:
        enable: {{ adaptiveProtection }}
        ruleVisibility: STANDARD
    advancedOptionsConfig:
      jsonParsing: STANDARD
      logLevel: {{ logLevel }}
    rules:
    - priority: 1000
      description: "Block traffic from restricted countries"
      action: deny(403)
      match:
        expr:
          expression: "origin.region_code in [{% for country in blockedCountries %}'{{ country }}'{% if not loop.last %}, {% endif %}{% endfor %}]"
      preview: false

    - priority: 2000
      description: "Rate limit requests per IP address"
      action: rate_based_ban
      rateLimitOptions:
        conformAction: allow
        exceedAction: deny(429)
        enforceOnKey: {{ enforceOnKey }}
        rateLimitThreshold:
          count: {{ rateLimitThresholdCount }}
          intervalSec: {{ rateLimitIntervalSec }}
        banDurationSec: {{ rateLimitBanDurationSec }}
        banThreshold:
          count: {{ rateLimitThresholdCount * 2 }}
          intervalSec: {{ rateLimitIntervalSec }}
      match:
        versionedExpr: SRC_IPS_V1
        config:
          srcIpRanges:
          - "*"
      preview: false

    - priority: 3000
      description: "Block known malicious IPs via preconfigured WAF rule - SQLi"
      action: deny(403)
      match:
        expr:
          expression: "evaluatePreconfiguredExpr('sqli-v33-stable')"
      preview: false

    - priority: 3100
      description: "Block XSS attacks via preconfigured WAF rule"
      action: deny(403)
      match:
        expr:
          expression: "evaluatePreconfiguredExpr('xss-v33-stable')"
      preview: false

    - priority: 3200
      description: "Block Local File Inclusion attacks"
      action: deny(403)
      match:
        expr:
          expression: "evaluatePreconfiguredExpr('lfi-v33-stable')"
      preview: false

    - priority: 3300
      description: "Block Remote File Inclusion attacks"
      action: deny(403)
      match:
        expr:
          expression: "evaluatePreconfiguredExpr('rfi-v33-stable')"
      preview: false

    - priority: 3400
      description: "Block Remote Code Execution attempts"
      action: deny(403)
      match:
        expr:
          expression: "evaluatePreconfiguredExpr('rce-v33-stable')"
      preview: false

    - priority: 2147483647
      description: "Default rule - allow all other traffic"
      action: allow
      match:
        versionedExpr: SRC_IPS_V1
        config:
          srcIpRanges:
          - "*"
      preview: false

outputs:
- name: securityPolicyName
  value: $(ref.{{ policyName }}.name)
- name: securityPolicySelfLink
  value: $(ref.{{ policyName }}.selfLink)
- name: securityPolicyId
  value: $(ref.{{ policyName }}.id)
